cases.sentence: Миновал полдень, а они продолжали неистовствовать до времени ___ .
cases.explain: «вечернего жертвоприношения» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.

cases.explain: «седьмой раз» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’ ”

cases.sentence: Тем временем небо потемнело от облаков, поднялся ветер, начался ___, и Ахав поехал в Изреель.
cases.explain: «сильный ливень» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
